summary.text: Justin Ruffridge, a Republican, was elected in 2022 to represent District 7 (Kenai and Soldotna) in the Alaska House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he moved to the Kenai/Soldotna area in 1994 and earned a Doctor of Pharmacy degree from Washington State University in 2008.

He owns pharmacies in Soldotna and Juneau with a business partner, chaired the Alaska Board of Pharmacy, and was appointed to the Soldotna City Council in 2019 and elected to a full term that October.
